captions.caption: A view of a gooseneck trailer hitch assembly inside a truck bed.
A person reaches for the crank handle of the trailer jack.
A person begins to turn the crank handle to lower the trailer.
The person continues cranking the handle to adjust the trailer height.
The trailer hitch moves downward toward the ball hitch in the bed.
The gooseneck trailer hitch connects with the ball hitch in the truck.
The trailer hitch is fully seated and locked onto the ball hitch.
A close-up shows the locked trailer hitch mechanism in the truck bed.
A man in a bright yellow hat works on the trailer landing gear.
The man pulls a pin to release the trailer's support leg.
The man continues to adjust the leg of the trailer support system.
The trailer support leg is retracted into its storage position.
A close-up shot shows a hand pulling a spring-loaded lock pin.
The trailer leg is manually lifted by the person to secure it.
The trailer leg is locked in place after being raised from the ground.
The person picks up a large wooden block from the grass.
The person lifts the wooden block that supported the trailer leg.
The person carries the wooden block toward the front of the trailer.
The person throws the wooden block into the pickup truck's bed.
The wooden block lands on top of other items in the truck bed.
A view of the flatbed trailer deck showing its side markings.
A hand reaches down near the trailer tire to grab a chock.
The person pulls a cable to remove a wheel chock from behind the tire.
The wheel chock is pulled away from the trailer tire on the dirt.
The person picks up two wheel chocks by their attached cables.
The person walks toward the front of the trailer carrying the chocks.
A wide view of the long flatbed trailer attached to the pickup truck.
The empty trailer sits in a field near a barn and trees.
A man walks toward a red tractor parked in an open barn.
A heavy metal chain lies on the wooden deck of the trailer.
The man approaches the red tractor to prepare for loading it.
The man enters the driver's seat of the red tractor.
The red tractor engine starts and it begins moving toward the trailer.
The red tractor drives out of the barn toward the trailer ramps.
The tractor approaches the rear ramps of the flatbed trailer.
The tractor's front tires touch the base of the metal ramps.
The tractor begins to climb up the ramps onto the trailer bed.
The tractor continues climbing the ramps with its front loader raised.
The front wheels of the tractor reach the flatbed trailer deck.
The tractor continues to drive forward onto the main trailer bed.
The tractor's front section moves further onto the trailer deck.
The rear wheels of the tractor move onto the trailer ramps.
The tractor drives forward over a chain lying on the trailer bed.
The tractor moves into its final position on the trailer deck.
A low-angle view from the trailer bed shows the tractor's front tires.
The tractor's undercarriage is visible as it drives over the camera.
A close-up view shows the front axle and steering components from below.
The tractor's engine and chassis are seen from a ground-level perspective.
The middle section of the tractor passes directly over the camera.
The rear hitch and mechanical assembly are seen from underneath.
The tractor's rear tire and axle pass over the camera lens.
The tractor is now parked securely on the flatbed trailer.
A man in a hat stands in front of the loaded trailer and truck.
The man smiles and gestures toward the camera while talking.
The man introduces himself as Hank and welcomes viewers to the farm.
The man points to the red tractor loaded on the gooseneck trailer.
The man explains he is taking the tractor, "Old Brutus," to the shop.
The man continues his explanation while standing by the trailer.
The man gestures with his hand while explaining the trailer's use.
The man points to the chain binder securing the tractor's rear.
